title: Automated Supply Chain Inventory Synchronization
business: Retailers managing multi-channel inventory across disparate legacy warehouse systems and modern e-commerce platforms.
problem: Manual data entry between warehouse management systems and storefronts leads to stock discrepancies, overselling, and significant operational overhead.
solution: Azure Logic Apps provides a serverless orchestration layer that uses managed connectors to poll legacy databases and push updates to cloud-based APIs, automating the synchronization process without requiring custom middleware infrastructure.
steps: Configure a recurrence trigger to poll the legacy warehouse database at defined intervals.
Utilize a managed connector to query the SQL database for recent inventory changes.
Apply a data transformation action to map legacy schema fields to the target e-commerce API format.
Execute an HTTP action to push the transformed inventory data to the storefront API.
Implement a conditional branch to send an email notification if the API response indicates a failure.
outcome: Improved inventory accuracy across channels and reduced manual administrative labor for supply chain teams.
limitation: Logic Apps have execution duration limits for long-running workflows; complex, high-volume data processing should be offloaded to Azure Functions to avoid timeout errors.
